findings.summary: Candidate (PC 5-class w2048) retrained on the grid regenerated with the discontinuous-conduction converter at 1000 substeps (AI-N27 option 2, S-21 corrected), same recipe and same split as the promoted run. Not promoted; the registry is unchanged.
Trained and evaluated on simulated data only (speed x severity x noise x plant-drift grid, DC plant with dcm x1000); no real-machine validation exists.
